Dark Shadow Quirk.name: Dark Shadow Quirk
Dark Shadow Quirk.description:
🌑 You have a talking shadow creature that reaches out from your body.

🌱 At the start you direct a creature your size in indoor light to reach a few meters, catch an object, strike an adult or briefly hold one person.
📈 With training: coordinated attacks, rescue carries, shelter under its body, flight while riding it.
⚠️ Your attached creature weakens in bright light, grows wild in darkness and cannot cross walls; hits hurt you and fear disrupts your control.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Loss of Control, as deep darkness can make your creature disobey.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Shadow Hand Catch, Clawside Shove
Dark Shadow Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: sentient shadow with own voice, judgment, feelings; directed, not puppeted. Start, indoor light: human-sized, few-meter reach; catch, strike an adult, briefly hold one person. Dark: bigger, stronger, less control; bright: smaller, weaker, timid. Growth, dark teamwork, long guarding, flight need training.
Limits: attached; cannot roam, douse lights, move other shadows or pass walls. Sun, flames, strong lamps weaken it; deep dark may make it attack the nearest person, allies too. Hits on it hurt, distract the user; it can refuse orders.
Quirk Strain: light: catch, shove; moderate: hold, short scout, rescue carry; heavy: long shelter, flight; severe: full-strength coordinated attack, deep-dark control.
Drawback: built in, the canon Loss of Control.
Canon: Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: user answers for its harm, even disobeying.
Look: beaked shadow.
